newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as TEM rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as TEM rates fall.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 487.00/488.00 as Central Bank dollar sales propped up the exchange rate after interest rates softened by nearly one point, traders said.
Yields on six month TEM paper, used as benchmark for wider interest rates, fell 88 basis points to 20.78 percent in the Central Bank's regular Wednesday auction.
"It was a quiet day until the TEM results came through," said one trader. "The (dollar) market then dried-up, although the Central Bank kept the exchange rate steady," he added.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
